purpose: Select one genuinely new complete-library supervised combination family for Campaign102 without reading Campaign102 design-matrix values, fitting coefficients, or reading any new validation or 2024-2025 return values.

campaign101_concept_scouting.relevant_prevalue_decision: ic_weighted_return_weighted_ridge_tree_or_neural_model was explicitly deferred for a later separately frozen campaign

candidate_queue_review.reason: Policy v58 explicitly forbids a same-campaign rescue or retry of Campaign101.
A performance-selected subset would violate the complete prevalue-frozen library boundary and create hidden multiplicity.
Negative coefficients could silently invert frozen terminal directions and zero coefficients could silently discard definitions.
It adds avoidable architecture and tuning multiplicity before a bounded convex supervised complete-library blend has been isolated.

It is a new supervised mechanism explicitly left open by Campaign101, keeps every frozen-direction component materially present, limits component dominance, fits only inside each expanding training partition, and exposes a finite three-value regularization catalog.

selected_family.name: full_numeric_library_bounded_simplex_ridge_130f
selected_family.economic_hypothesis: The relative usefulness of frozen microstructure, path, activity, market-relative, disclosure, and quality signals may vary, but a training-only bounded positive blend can emphasize persistent complements while retaining every direction and limiting single-factor dominance over a three-session horizon.
selected_family.component_score: For each source independently on each session, use its v58 frozen direction, average ties, and percentile ranks in (0,1].
selected_family.support_equivalence: The 130th source is Campaign101 and is finite exactly when at least 97 of its 129 inputs are finite; requiring at least 98 finite values in the 130-vector is therefore exactly the already-observed Campaign101 support predicate, not a narrower predicate.
selected_family.training_target: Within every contained training signal session, average-tie percentile rank the finite t+1-open to t+3-close gross return ascending so higher realized return has a higher target in (0,1].
selected_family.objective: For each fold and lambda, minimize the session-equal mean squared error between target rank and Xw plus lambda times the squared Euclidean distance from uniform weights.
selected_family.optimizer: deterministic scipy SLSQP on frozen sufficient statistics, uniform initialization, ftol=1e-12, maxiter=2000, fail closed on non-convergence or constraint violation

sequential_information_protocol.step_1: Build and bind the 2019-2025 130-component directional-rank design matrix without daily prices or returns.
sequential_information_protocol.step_2: For a fold, read only its contained and purged training returns and fit all three frozen lambda trials.
sequential_information_protocol.step_3: Score every daily row in that fold's validation year and compare each score with all 130 numeric components before reading that fold's validation returns.
sequential_information_protocol.step_4: Only trials passing all 130 strict uniqueness comparisons may read and evaluate that fold's validation returns; process folds chronologically so an earlier validation year becomes later training only after its audit and evaluation.
sequential_information_protocol.step_5: Select at most one survivor using the frozen development gates. Refit on 2019-2023, audit 2024-2025 scores against all 130 components, then and only then consume the historically exposed 2024-2025 lockbox once.

decision.next_action: Complete the mandatory prevalue mechanism/support audit and freeze the exact fingerprint-bound no-return and sequential walk-forward protocol before building the design matrix or fitting any model.
